text:
Avery (AR): Heads up — noticed a promo credit got applied to a Dedicated reserved invoice instead of Hosted usage. Customer saw a shortfall on their Hosted charges. Can someone confirm? :eyes:
Sasha (Finance): Oof. Which invoice/credit code? We should avoid touching committed reservation invoices unless approved.
Avery (AR): INV-2026-1147 and credit PROMO-APR24 (code: PR-APR24-7G). Preview shows promo applied to line with `type: DEDICATED_RESERVE`.
Mohit (Cloud Ops): That sounds like the ledger mapping bug we saw last quarter where `promo_default` routing was falling back to the wrong billing_center. Can you paste the billing lines?
Avery (AR): Sure — snippet from billing export:
```
invoice_id: INV-2026-1147
customer_id: CUST-881
lines:
  - sku: DEDICATED_RESERVE
    period: 2026-02
    amount: 12000.00
    credits_applied: ["PR-APR24-7G"]
  - sku: HOSTED_API
    period: 2026-02
    amount: 3400.00
    credits_applied: []
```
Sasha (Finance): Thanks. That matches what I see in the ledger. PR-APR24 still had $8,400 remaining and it was consumed by the dedicated line. We need to reallocate to Hosted lines and leave reserved invoices intact (contract credits shouldn't apply to reserved commitments).
Lina (Eng Infra): FYI reserved/dedicated invoices are generated off the commitments service (ledger COMMIT_2026). Hosted usage uses USAGE_2026. They shouldn't share promos but the billing pipeline merges credits at apply-time. Looks like the priority rules were changed in the last billing patch.
Jules (Legal): If this touches a customer contract for Reserved capacity we need written approval before we move credits across invoice types. Any movement could change recognition.
Kai (Billing Ops): I can do a manual reallocation if Finance + Legal OK. Proposed delta: remove PR-APR24 from INV-2026-1147 DEDICATED_RESERVE line and apply $8,400 to INV-2026-1149 HOSTED_API (same customer). Will produce a journal entry: `offset: reserved->hosted PR-APR24`. Need signoff. :+1:
Sasha (Finance): Approve pending confirmation from Legal. Jules — can you sign off on reallocation to preserve revenue recognition?
Jules (Legal): Approve for customer experience reasons, provided we note it in the contract addendum. Kai, proceed and add memo `manual reallocation per ticket BILL-4127`.
billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4127 — Billing Ops manual reallocation requested by Sasha. Assigned to Kai.
Mohit (Cloud Ops): I'll add a short fix to the billing pipeline to make `promo_priority` prefer USAGE_ ledger for promo-type `trial/promo` next week. Will open PR and tag @Lina for review.
Avery (AR): Thanks all. Customer-facing note drafted, will be sent after reallocation completes.
Sasha (Finance): After reallocation, finance will reconcile month-end. Please also confirm whether cloud provider credits (e.g., GCP credits) were used — those are separate and shouldn't be touched.
Kai (Billing Ops): Reallocation completed. Journal: `J-2026-9987` attached. PR-APR24 now shows applied to Hosted lines. Customer balance updated.
Avery (AR): Customer notified, they responded :heart: — thanks everyone.
Sasha (Finance): I'll record this as a process action: 1) block promos from applying to COMMIT_* ledgers 2) add monitoring alert when a credit is applied to reserved SKU. Filing follow-up: BILL-4128 for pipeline rule.
Lina (Eng Infra): Noted. I'll add a unit test for ledger routing in the billing test harness.
Mohit (Cloud Ops): :thumbsup:
